title: OutboxRecord v1
description: P2.1 (external audit 2026-09-11): runtime shape check for a DynamoDB Streams image of an OutboxEvent row (src/shared/outbox/outbox.ts's OutboxRecord), consumed by DispatchOutboxRelay (dispatch-outbox-relay-processor.ts). This is an internal single-table row, not an external event/queue envelope - deliberately does NOT enumerate OutboxDestination/eventType/aggregateType as closed sets (both grow routinely as new producers are added; a closed enum here would need updating every time, the exact kind of schema drift this check exists to catch, not create). Validates presence/type of the fields the relay actually reads (PK/SK/status/payload/tenantId/eventType/destination), never the full DynamoDB item verbatim.
